status: frozen route-allocation contract before signal geometry

geometry_rules.via_stack_ownership: every cut must overlap same-net conductor above and below
geometry_rules.pin_stack: LI-only pins use explicit viali/M1/via1; existing-M1 pins begin at via1

layer_policy.metal1: terminal pad and shortest safe escape only; never a row-scale route
layer_policy.metal2: short horizontal pin escape and compact same-row connection
layer_policy.metal3: vertical leaves, adjacent-row links, and the shielded service bundle
layer_policy.metal4: horizontal regional trunks and named crossings only

service_bundle.rule: one straight shielded spine per net; region fanout leaves on M4 at named branch points

direct_boundary_bundle.rule: one straight phase/global boundary column per net; singleton phase-bank channel-enable columns land on the measured sink pin while shared columns remain median-demand; columns keep at least 0.8 um pitch and avoid power straps

phase_selector.rule: one monotonic drop from its global driver to the already frozen channel column

quadrature_roots.rule: four ordered wires; no phase crossing and no compensating meander

trim_outputs.rule: Q pin uses its unique pre-placed M3 column and joins exactly one monotonic M2 bus row

blanking.rule: observation-only logical status; do not create a physical route because per-channel phase_enable already contains blanking and there is no analog load or real macro port at the former (123.28,176.0) placeholder

local_topology_selection.rule: short same-row/adjacent-row nets use M2/M3 directly; the 21 um limit admits the measured three-pin manual-code feedback links without a regional trunk; wider or higher-fanout nets receive one interval-colored M4 trunk

release_gates: all mapped signal nets and all required external/handoff anchors belong to one extracted component each
every service pin retains a direct M1-to-M2 via landing free of earlier signal routes
no signal component contains VDPWR or VGND
no route shape enters a passive, analog-current, output, phase, power, or boundary keepout without ownership
no via exists without same-net metal above and below
no floating metal rectangle, transition landing, or obsolete route stub exists
observation-only mixers_blank has no physical route unless a real consuming pin is added
every local route satisfies its direction-reversal budget
clock and quadrature routes pass extracted delay/skew checks at 4 MHz and the 30 MHz characterization target
Magic full DRC, topology extraction, direct-GDS flat checks, and distributed-RC coverage all pass
